lead: Annibale Carracci was an Italian painter and instructor, active in Bologna and later in Rome.
paras: Along with his younger brother Agostino Carracci and elder cousin Ludovico Carracci, Annibale was one of the progenitors, if not founders of a leading strand of the Baroque style, borrowing from styles from both north and south of their native city, and aspiring for a return to classical monumentality, but adding a more vital dynamism.
